name: T-Rex 2X Long FIGR Daily Target ETF
name_en: T-Rex 2X Long FIGR Daily Target ETF
desc: The fund, under normal circumstances, invests at least 80% of its net assets (plus any borrowings for investment purposes) in financial instruments that are designed to provide, in the aggregate, 200% exposure to the price performance of FIGR on a daily basis. The fund will attempt to achieve its investment objective without regard to overall market movement or the increase or decrease of the value of FIGR. The fund is non-diversified.
